name: com.lucasjramos.spritekiln
description: Imports SpriteKiln renders (.kiln): animated 8-direction or side-view pixel-art sprites with exact frame timing, gameplay events, sockets, a normal map for 2D lights and an emissive layer. KilnAnimator plays them; AnimationClips are generated for the Animator.

samples.description: A gargoyle that walks and attacks in 8 directions: KilnAnimator, events and the strike socket. Add GargoyleDemo to an empty GameObject, drop gargula.kiln on Sheet, press Play.
